title: Demand Curve Shift Diagram
subject: Economics
caption: Demand curve with arrows showing movement along the curve, rightward shift due to higher income, and leftward shift due to taste change.
altText: A Cartesian graph with a white background. The vertical axis is labeled Price (P) and the horizontal axis is labeled Quantity (Q). A downward‑sloping blue line labeled D represents the original demand curve. Two dashed curves, a green D1 shifted rightward and a red D2 shifted leftward, show possible demand shifts. A black arrow along D points from a higher price‑lower quantity point to a lower price‑higher quantity point, labeled “Price change”. A vertical black arrow upward from D to D1 is labeled “Income ↑” indicating a rightward shift. Another vertical black arrow downward from D to D2 is labeled “Taste ↓” indicating a leftward shift. All lines are clear black strokes with arrowheads.
